title: Satin Sleeveless Ball-Gown Wedding Guest Dress
descriptionHtml:
This elegant satin midi dress features a clean sleeveless neckline, structured bodice and softly flared skirt that moves beautifully with every step. The tailored waist creates a flattering silhouette while hidden pockets add modern practicality. Perfect for wedding guests, cocktail parties, rehearsal dinners, formal dinners and special occasions that call for timeless sophistication.

?

Size Tip: Please choose your size based on bust and waist measurements. If your bust and waist fall into different sizes, we recommend choosing the larger size.


Fit: Please refer to size chart.


Length: Midi.


Sleeve Style: Sleeveless.


Closure: Back zipper.


Undergarments: It is not padded, with lining.


Fabric:The garment comprises satin.


Stretch: Fabric is non-stretch.
